# Eventer

> Eventer is a type-safe analytics event catalog platform. Teams define analytics events once with typed properties, then Eventer generates strongly-typed SDKs for Web (JavaScript/TypeScript), iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), and JVM (Java/Kotlin). Events can be routed to any combination of analytics destinations including Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase Analytics, Segment, Adobe Analytics, AppsFlyer, LaunchDarkly, Braze, and Adjust.

Eventer solves the common analytics implementation problems of inconsistent event naming across platforms, lack of type safety causing runtime errors and data-quality issues, siloed implementations between teams, and schema drift over time. Events are defined once in a central catalog with typed properties (string, number, boolean, enum, etc.), then code generation produces idiomatic per-platform SDKs with full IDE autocompletion and compile-time validation.

Eventer also ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at `https://eventer.premex.se/api/mcp` so AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) can read and modify event definitions, publish events, and queue SDK builds directly from the editor.

## Documentation

- [Introduction to Eventer](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/introduction): Learn how to set up Eventer to track events effectively.
- [Android SDK Implementation Guide](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/android-implementation): How to use the Eventer Android SDK in your app.
- [Consumer Plugin (Gradle)](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/consumer-plugin): Generate type-safe event tracking code at build time using the Eventer consumer Gradle plugin.
- [Export Mixpanel Lexicon to Eventer](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/export-mixpanel-lexicon-events-to-eventer): Learn how to export Mixpanel events in Lexicon to Eventer.
- [Gradle Integration Guide](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/gradle): Learn how to integrate the Eventer SDK into any project using Gradle.
- [iOS Integration via XCFramework](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/xcframework): Learn how to integrate the Eventer iOS SDK into your project using XCFramework.
- [iOS SDK Implementation Guide](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/ios-implementation): How to use the Eventer iOS SDK in your app.
- [Java Integration via Maven](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/maven): Learn how to integrate the Eventer Java SDK into your project using Maven.
- [JavaScript Integration via npm](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/npm): Learn how to integrate the Eventer JavaScript SDK into your project using npm.
- [Setting Up Eventer MCP](https://eventer.premex.se/docs/setting-up-eventer-mcp): Learn how to set up and use Eventer's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI-assisted event management.
